_upstream.body_excerpt:
Classify voice session failures and record terminal outcomes

## Why

Voice failure metrics lacked cause and lifecycle phase, and session durations were recorded before the final outcome was known. A failed control send could also overwrite a more specific WebRTC error.

## What changed

- Tag `codex.voice.session.failure` with bounded `cause` and `phase` values, recording at most one failure per session.
- Capture duration when stopping and emit `codex.voice.session.duration` at cleanup with a `success` or `failure` outcome.
- Carry typed WebRTC errors into the TUI, preserve existing errors when control sends fail, and avoid duplicate errors after startup failure.
- Record app-server disconnect failures for background voice sessions as well as the visible session.

## Testing

Add coverage for terminal outcome and failure metric attributes, preservation of specific startup and audio-session errors, and startup failures without duplicate control-channel errors.
